name: The Seventh Day
overview: Scripture reveals that God completed His creative work in six days and rested on the seventh, blessing and sanctifying this day as a holy time of rest (Genesis 2:2-3; Exodus 20:11). The seventh day, or Sabbath, is commanded to be kept holy as a perpetual sign between God and His people, emphasizing rest and cessation from labor (Exodus 20:8; 31:15,17). This divine rest not only commemorates God's creative work but also serves as a sacred covenantal marker, underscoring God's lordship and the call for His people to honor His provision and holiness.
